title: Aldous Huxley takes a high dose of LSD while dying
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Aldous Huxley takes a high dose of LSD while dying, about 1963 at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> he I think at the end of his life was uh was dying and he asked his wife to uh give him an extremely high dose of LSD.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the writer Aldous Huxley, as he lay dying in 1963, asked his wife to give him a very high dose of LSD, a powerful mind-altering drug. Michels brings it up while talking about psychedelics as a door to other states of mind.
